g.text: Fusion assumptions change the precipitation window
15% share in every case · Four thermal descriptions · This is model sensitivity, not an uncertainty interval

g.text: Dispersed-crystal viscosity, not gel/yield behavior. Heavy liquid baselines and high-MW fusion extrapolations remain unreliable.
